comment: Kingdom ID stores only name and updated_at from the profile scope; OIDC Core 5.4 makes the rest optional.
acr_values is a voluntary request (OIDC Core 3.1.2.1); no acr claim is issued until authentication levels exist (passkeys, phase 4).
The claims request parameter is not supported (claims_parameter_supported: false in discovery), so an essential claim requested only through it is not released.
